note: The raw request buffer is interpreted as a PROXY header before normal HTTP parsing.
The parser treats attacker bytes as a fixed-layout PROXY v2 header and reads the declared length field from it.

code: size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (size > sizeof(*hdr)) return NULL;
note: The code assumes the entire PROXY v2 frame must fit inside sizeof(*hdr), but the struct is only the minimum header size and not the full possible frame payload.

The parser later null-terminates based on the computed length, so if the proxy length drives buffer state past the true request boundary, the write can target memory outside the intended request data.
